purpose: Independent service review for official Surrey public parcel-map evidence; runtime qualification is intentionally held for serial review.
assessment: The City of Surrey's first-party Maps & COSMOS page identifies the public mapping system and links the city GIS service. The official ArcGIS REST lots layer returned safe polygon geometry from an unchanged exact-point request and a nearby bounded envelope request. The evidence supports local public parcel geometry, not citywide completeness or legal-title authority.
registryAssessment: A local municipal GIS custodian is evidenced: City of Surrey GIS/Engineering maintains COSMOS and property information, and its public service returned parcel polygons. This does not establish the provincial land-title registry as integrated, and no unsafe title or ownership data was requested.
